zh.summary: RunningHub 是雲端 ComfyUI 平台，不用裝顯卡就能在瀏覽器一鍵執行別人做好的 AI 工作流；這個工作流可自動產出音樂 MV，據作者說跑一次成本約新台幣 5 元。

en.summary: RunningHub is a cloud ComfyUI platform that runs ready-made AI workflows in the browser, no GPU needed; this workflow auto-generates music videos, about NT$5 per run according to its author.

zh.summary: GitHub 上熱門的開源 Claude Skill：對 Claude 說一句話，就自動在「剪映專業版」生成剪輯草稿，素材排列、配樂、字幕、AI 配音、轉場都幫你搭好，再到剪映檢查匯出。只支援電腦版剪映專業版（國內版），CapCut 與手機版不支援。
zh.use: 把商品實拍素材一句話剪成開箱、新品短影音草稿，再快速做出不同長度的版本測廣告。完整步驟請點「安裝教學」。

en.summary: A popular open-source Claude skill: describe the video in one sentence and Claude builds a draft in JianYing Pro (剪映专业版) with clips, music, captions, AI voice-over and transitions laid out, ready to review and export. Desktop JianYing Pro (mainland-China version) only; CapCut and mobile are not supported.
en.use: Turn raw product footage into unboxing or launch short-video drafts in one sentence, then spin up different lengths for ad tests. See the install guide for full steps.

zh.summary: 免費開源工具，讓你在自己的電競電腦上離線跑 1250 億參數的大型 AI 模型（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next），能聊天、寫文案、寫程式、看圖，資料完全不出你的電腦，還提供 OpenAI／Anthropic 相容 API 讓其他工具串接。硬體門檻：顯卡 12GB 以上、記憶體 32GB 起（64GB 最順）、硬碟約 80GB。中文請選 Q2_0 或 IQ2_XS 版本。
zh.use: 大量生成商品描述、廣告文案、SEO 標題不用付 API 費；處理顧客名單、訂單、評價等敏感資料不上雲；當 n8n／Make 自動化或客服機器人背後的 AI 引擎。適合有電競電腦的進階學員。

en.summary: Free, open-source engine that runs a 125B-parameter model (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) offline on your own gaming PC: chat, copywriting, coding and image understanding, with nothing leaving your machine, plus an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API for other tools. Needs a 12 GB+ GPU, 32 GB+ RAM (64 GB ideal) and about 80 GB of disk. For Chinese, pick the Q2_0 or IQ2_XS build.
en.use: Generate product descriptions, ad copy and SEO titles in bulk with no API fees; process customer lists, orders and reviews without sending them to the cloud; power n8n/Make automations or support bots. For advanced students with a gaming PC.
